Name: Customized CC Bundles - Community Center Randomizer
Author: Dominikkovi
Description:
[center][b][color=#00ff00][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]TEAM JUNIMO[/font][/size][/color][/b] [/center]
[line]
[b]Randomized Bundles 2.0 — Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]
Randomized Bundles completely changes how the Community Center works. Instead of the same bundles every playthrough, this mod generates a new randomized set each time you start a save. You can no longer rely on memory or a wiki — you have to actually think about what to bring.
You have full control over how bundles are built. Choose the item category, difficulty preset, stack sizes, quality rules, and even set a hotkey for instant rerolls. Every setting is yours to configure.
[line]
[b]Main Features[/b]
[b]Fully Customizable Bundles[/b] Configure everything through the Generic Mod Config Menu:
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Category[/b] [/size]— Choose a theme:
[i][b]Anything,
Miner,
Farmer,
Fisherman,
Artisan,
Forager,
Chef, or
Woodcutter.[/b][/i]
Anything picks randomly across all item types.[/*]
[*][size=4][b]Difficulty[/b] [/size]— Choose a preset that controls slot counts, stack sizes, and quality rules all at once:
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Very Easy[/b][/font] — 1–2 slots, stacks up to 5, no quality[/*]
[*][b]Easy [/b]— 1–3 slots, stacks up to 20, silver allowed[/*]
[*][b]Normal [/b]— 3–6 slots, stacks up to 50, silver and gold allowed[/*]
[*][b]Hard [/b]— 5–8 slots, stacks up to 100, silver and gold allowed[/*]
[*][b]Extreme [/b]— 8–12 slots, stacks up to 500, all qualities allowed[/*]
[*][b]Custom [/b]— Uses your own values from the settings below[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b][font=sans-serif][size=4]Only Vanilla Items[/size] [/font][/b]— When enabled, modded items are excluded from bundle generation.[/*]
[*][b][size=4]Reroll Key[/size][/b] — Set a keyboard button to instantly reroll all bundles in-game. Defaults to [b]R[/b]. Set to [i][b]None[/b][/i] to disable.[/*]
[/list][b]Custom Difficulty Settings[/b][i][b][font=Georgia](only active when Difficulty is set to [size=4]Custom[/size])[/font][/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Min/Max slots per bundle[/*]
[*]Min/Max stack size per item slot[/*]
[*]Individual toggles for Silver ★, Gold ★★, and Iridium ★★★★ quality items[/*]
[/list]Quality only applies to items that can naturally have a quality rating (crops, fish, forage, eggs, milk, and artisan goods). Everything else is always set to normal quality, so every bundle stays completable.
[line]
[b]Permanent Room Rewards[/b] Completing a room grants a permanent stat bonus:
[list]
[*]Crafts Room → +1 Speed[/*]
[*]Bulletin Board → +1 Luck[/*]
[*]Pantry → +1 Farming[/*]
[*]Fish Tank → +1 Fishing[/*]
[*]Boiler Room → +1 Mining[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Value-Based Rewards[/b] The mod calculates the total gold value of everything you donate and generates a matching reward from it. The difficulty preset scales this further — easier difficulties give more generous rewards, harder ones give less.
[line]
[b]Save-Linked Randomization[/b] Bundle data is saved directly inside your save file, so your bundles stay consistent between sessions. They only change when you use the reroll command or keybind.
[line]
[b]Grand Finale Bonus[/b] Completing the entire Community Center rewards you with a [b]Stardrop[/b] and an [b]Iridium Snake Milk[/b] as a special thank-you from the Junimos.
[line]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] — Make sure you have version 4.0.0 or higher.[/*]
[*]Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] [i](recommended)[/i] — Allows you to change all settings from inside the game.[/*]
[*][b]Download and extract[/b] — Place the [font=serif][i][b]RandomizedBundles[/b][/i] [/font]folder into your [b][i][font=serif]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][/i][/b] directory.[/*]
[*][b]Launch the game[/b] — Run through [b][i]StardewModdingAPI.exe. [/i][/b]Bundles are generated the first time you load a save.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Console Commands[/b]
[list]
[*][size=4]reroll_bundles [/size]— Wipes current bundle data and generates a new set using your current settings. Useful if you change your category or difficulty mid-game.[/*]
[*]However you can config a custom button to do it. It is the button [b][font=Arial Black]"R" [/font][/b]normally.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.0 or higher[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Credits[/b]
[list]
[*]ConcernedApe — For the 1.6 update that made modding these systems more stable and flexible.[/*]
[*]The SMAPI Community — For documentation on asset editing and save data systems.[/*]
[/list]
